title: Seas & Straits
source: Compiled from general geographic knowledge — no study notes supplied

groups.name: The oil chokepoints
groups.mnemonic: Hormuz, Bab-el-Mandeb, Malacca, Suez, Gibraltar, Panama — the six the tanker world worries about

groups.name: The Turkish Straits
groups.mnemonic: Bosporus then Dardanelles — Black Sea, Marmara, Aegean, in that order

groups.name: India's degree channels
groups.mnemonic: Ten splits Andaman from Nicobar; Nine splits Lakshadweep; Eight splits India from the Maldives

groups.name: The Danish Straits
groups.mnemonic: Skagerrak, Kattegat, Øresund — the staircase from the North Sea down into the Baltic

groups.name: Up the Atlantic coast of Europe
groups.mnemonic: ABC — Alboran, Biscay, Celtic, a stack read bottom to top: Alboran at Gibraltar, Biscay off France, Celtic below Ireland

groups.name: The Baltic waters
groups.mnemonic: BBRF, said as "B-barf" (the ice) — Bothnia, Baltic, Riga, Finland

groups.name: Inland from the Aegean
groups.mnemonic: MBA — Marmara, Black, Azov, the three seas in that order as you head inland, each behind its own gate: Dardanelles, Bosporus, Kerch

groups.name: Countries on the Black Sea
groups.mnemonic: T-BURGR — Turkey, Bulgaria, Ukraine, Romania, Georgia, Russia, the six that touch it

groups.name: Countries on the Caspian Sea
groups.mnemonic: TARIK — Turkmenistan, Azerbaijan, Russia, Iran, Kazakhstan, the five that touch it

groups.name: The seas either side of Italy and Greece
groups.mnemonic: Rule a line down each peninsula, northwest to southeast — left of it the sea starts with A, right of it it ends in -ian

places.name: Pacific Ocean
places.significance: Largest and deepest ocean, holding the Mariana Trench
notes: Covers about a third of the Earth's surface

places.name: Atlantic Ocean
places.significance: Second largest ocean, split by the Mid-Atlantic Ridge
notes: Busiest ocean for trade between Europe and the Americas

places.name: Indian Ocean
places.significance: Third largest ocean, and the only one named after a country
notes: Its monsoon winds drove the earliest long-distance sea trade

places.name: Arctic Ocean
places.significance: Smallest and shallowest ocean, ice-covered for much of the year
notes: Melting ice is opening the Northern Sea Route along Russia's coast

places.name: Southern Ocean
places.significance: Ring of water around Antarctica, carrying the Antarctic Circumpolar Current
notes: The only ocean that circles the globe unbroken by land

places.name: Mediterranean Sea
places.significance: Almost landlocked sea between Europe, Africa and Asia — the cradle of Western trade
notes: Reaches the Atlantic only through the Strait of Gibraltar

places.name: Adriatic Sea
places.significance: Arm of the Mediterranean between Italy and the Balkans
notes: Venice and Trieste sit at its head

places.name: Aegean Sea
places.significance: Island-filled sea between Greece and Turkey

places.name: Ionian Sea
places.significance: Deepest part of the Mediterranean, south of the Adriatic

places.name: Tyrrhenian Sea
places.significance: Sea enclosed by mainland Italy, Sicily, Sardinia and Corsica

places.name: Ligurian Sea
places.significance: Sea of the Italian and French Riviera, north of Corsica

places.name: Alboran Sea
places.significance: Westernmost basin of the Mediterranean, just inside Gibraltar

places.name: Black Sea
places.significance: Inland sea reaching the Mediterranean only through the Turkish Straits
notes: Its deep water is anoxic — almost lifeless below about 150m

places.name: Sea of Azov
places.significance: Shallowest sea in the world, joined to the Black Sea by the Kerch Strait

places.name: Sea of Marmara
places.significance: Small sea wholly inside Turkey, between the Bosporus and the Dardanelles
notes: It is what makes the two Turkish Straits a pair

places.name: Caspian Sea
places.significance: Largest inland water body on Earth, with no outlet to any ocean
notes: Its legal status — sea or lake — decides how its oil is divided

places.name: Baltic Sea
places.significance: Brackish northern European sea reached through the Danish Straits
notes: So little salt that it freezes in hard winters

places.name: Gulf of Bothnia
places.significance: Northern arm of the Baltic between Sweden and Finland

places.name: Gulf of Finland
places.significance: Eastern arm of the Baltic, giving Russia its St Petersburg outlet

places.name: Gulf of Riga
places.significance: Baltic inlet between Latvia and Estonia, sheltered by the island of Saaremaa
notes: Riga, Latvia's capital, stands at its head

places.name: North Sea
places.significance: Shallow shelf sea, Europe's great oil, gas and fishing ground
notes: The Dogger Bank is one of the richest fisheries in Europe

places.name: Norwegian Sea
places.significance: Deep sea off Norway kept ice-free by the North Atlantic Drift

places.name: Barents Sea
places.significance: Arctic sea that stays partly ice-free, giving Russia its Murmansk port

places.name: Greenland Sea
places.significance: Between Greenland and Svalbard, a main source of deep Atlantic water

places.name: White Sea
places.significance: Inlet of the Barents Sea wholly inside Russia, port of Arkhangelsk

places.name: Kara Sea
places.significance: Ice-choked Siberian sea taking the Ob and Yenisei rivers

places.name: Laptev Sea
places.significance: Siberian sea called the birthplace of Arctic sea ice

places.name: East Siberian Sea
places.significance: Coldest and most ice-covered stretch of the Northern Sea Route

places.name: Chukchi Sea
places.significance: Arctic sea just north of the Bering Strait, shared by Russia and Alaska

places.name: Beaufort Sea
places.significance: Arctic sea north of Alaska and the Yukon, with a disputed sea boundary

places.name: Irish Sea
places.significance: Sea separating Ireland from Great Britain

places.name: Celtic Sea
places.significance: Shelf sea south of Ireland, opening to the Atlantic

places.name: Bay of Biscay
places.significance: Notoriously stormy bay off western France and northern Spain

places.name: Caribbean Sea
places.significance: Sea enclosed by the West Indies and Central America, feeding the Gulf Stream

places.name: Gulf of Mexico
places.significance: Great oil and hurricane basin, where the Gulf Stream is born

places.name: Sargasso Sea
places.significance: The only sea with no coastline — bounded entirely by ocean currents
notes: Named for its floating sargassum weed; where eels go to spawn

places.name: Labrador Sea
places.significance: Between Canada and Greenland, a main site of deep-water formation

places.name: Hudson Bay
places.significance: Vast shallow bay biting into Canada, frozen for much of the year

places.name: Baffin Bay
places.significance: Between Baffin Island and Greenland, the iceberg nursery of the Atlantic

places.name: James Bay
places.significance: Southern arm of Hudson Bay, reaching down towards Ontario and Quebec

places.name: Gulf of Boothia
places.significance: Arctic gulf between the Boothia Peninsula and Baffin Island

places.name: Bay of Campeche
places.significance: Southern bight of the Gulf of Mexico, and Mexico's main offshore oil field
notes: Cantarell, once one of the largest oil fields in the world, lies here

places.name: Gulf of Panama
places.significance: Pacific-side gulf where the Panama Canal comes out

places.name: Gulf of St Lawrence
places.significance: Mouth of the St Lawrence, Canada's gateway to the Great Lakes

places.name: Bay of Fundy
places.significance: Highest tidal range in the world, over 15 metres

places.name: Gulf of Guinea
places.significance: West African oil coast, where the Equator meets the Prime Meridian offshore
notes: Piracy here rivals the Horn of Africa

places.name: Arabian Sea
places.significance: Sea between India and Arabia carrying the Gulf's oil to the world

places.name: Bay of Bengal
places.significance: Largest bay in the world, and the cyclone alley of South Asia

places.name: Laccadive Sea
places.significance: Warm sea between southern India, Sri Lanka and the Maldives

places.name: Andaman Sea
places.significance: Sea east of the Andaman Islands, opening into the Strait of Malacca

places.name: Red Sea
places.significance: Suez-to-Bab-el-Mandeb corridor, one of the world's saltiest seas
notes: Sits on a spreading rift — Africa and Arabia are pulling apart

places.name: Gulf of Aden
places.significance: Piracy-prone approach between the Horn of Africa and Arabia

places.name: Persian Gulf
places.significance: Shallow gulf holding the greatest concentration of oil on Earth
notes: Its single exit is the Strait of Hormuz

places.name: Gulf of Oman
places.significance: The Arabian Sea's antechamber, leading to the Strait of Hormuz

places.name: Gulf of Aqaba
places.significance: Eastern arm of the Red Sea, Israel's and Jordan's only southern outlet

places.name: Gulf of Suez
places.significance: Western arm of the Red Sea, the approach to the Suez Canal

places.name: Gulf of Kutch
places.significance: Gujarat inlet holding Kandla and India's largest oil-handling ports

places.name: Gulf of Khambhat
places.significance: Funnel-shaped Gujarat gulf with India's highest tidal range

places.name: Gulf of Mannar
places.significance: Biosphere reserve between India and Sri Lanka, south of Rameswaram

places.name: Timor Sea
places.significance: Gas-rich sea between Timor and northern Australia

places.name: Arafura Sea
places.significance: Shallow sea between Australia and New Guinea, north of the Gulf of Carpentaria

places.name: Gulf of Carpentaria
places.significance: Great rectangular gulf cut into northern Australia

places.name: Great Australian Bight
places.significance: Long open bight along Australia's southern coast

places.name: South China Sea
places.significance: The world's most contested sea, carrying a third of global shipping
notes: Spratly and Paracel Islands are claimed by several states at once

places.name: East China Sea
places.significance: Sea between China and Japan, home of the disputed Senkaku Islands

places.name: Yellow Sea
places.significance: Named for the silt the Yellow River pours into it

places.name: Sea of Japan
places.significance: Marginal sea walled off by the Japanese islands; Korea calls it the East Sea

places.name: Sea of Okhotsk
places.significance: Ice-bound Russian sea closed off by Kamchatka and the Kurils

places.name: Bering Sea
places.significance: Sea north of the Aleutians, among the richest fisheries on Earth

places.name: Philippine Sea
places.significance: Holds the Mariana Trench, the deepest point in any ocean
notes: Challenger Deep lies about 11 km down

places.name: Celebes Sea
places.significance: Deep basin between Borneo, Sulawesi and Mindanao

places.name: Sulu Sea
places.significance: Sea inside the Philippine archipelago, west of the Visayas

places.name: Banda Sea
places.significance: Deep Indonesian sea of the old Spice Islands

places.name: Java Sea
places.significance: Shallow shelf sea between Java, Sumatra and Borneo

places.name: Flores Sea
places.significance: Sea north of the Lesser Sunda Islands

places.name: Molucca Sea
places.significance: Narrow sea between Sulawesi and Halmahera, on the Equator

places.name: Coral Sea
places.significance: Holds the Great Barrier Reef along Australia's north-east coast

places.name: Tasman Sea
places.significance: Stormy sea between Australia and New Zealand — the "Tasman"

places.name: Bismarck Sea
places.significance: Sea north of New Guinea, inside the Bismarck Archipelago

places.name: Solomon Sea
places.significance: Sea between New Guinea and the Solomon Islands

places.name: Gulf of Thailand
places.significance: Shallow gulf enclosed by the Malay and Indochinese peninsulas

places.name: Gulf of Tonkin
places.significance: Gulf between northern Vietnam and Hainan, with Halong Bay on its shore

places.name: Gulf of California
places.significance: Long gulf splitting the Baja Peninsula from mainland Mexico

places.name: Gulf of Alaska
places.significance: Storm-breeding gulf on Alaska's southern coast

places.name: Ross Sea
places.significance: Deep Antarctic bay holding the Ross Ice Shelf, the world's largest

places.name: Weddell Sea
places.significance: Antarctic sea whose pack ice crushed Shackleton's Endurance

places.name: Amundsen Sea
places.significance: West Antarctic sea whose thinning glaciers drive sea-level rise

places.name: Scotia Sea
places.significance: Sea between South America and Antarctica, ringed by the Scotia Arc

places.name: Strait of Gibraltar
places.significance: The Mediterranean's only natural door to the Atlantic, 14 km wide
notes: The Rock of Gibraltar is a British territory on the Spanish side

places.name: Bosporus
places.significance: Splits Istanbul between Europe and Asia; Russia's grain route west
notes: Governed with the Dardanelles under the Montreux Convention

places.name: Dardanelles
places.significance: The second Turkish Strait, and the Gallipoli campaign's prize

places.name: Strait of Messina
places.significance: Narrow gap between Sicily and mainland Italy — Homer's Scylla and Charybdis

places.name: Strait of Otranto
places.significance: Closes the mouth of the Adriatic between Italy and Albania

places.name: Strait of Sicily
places.significance: The Mediterranean's own waist, between Sicily and Tunisia

places.name: Strait of Bonifacio
places.significance: Separates French Corsica from Italian Sardinia

places.name: Strait of Dover
places.significance: Busiest shipping lane in the world; the Channel Tunnel runs beneath it
notes: Only about 33 km wide

places.name: English Channel
places.significance: The water that has kept Britain an island, narrowing to the Strait of Dover

places.name: Kerch Strait
places.significance: The only way into the Sea of Azov, between Crimea and Russia

places.name: Skagerrak
places.significance: First step of the Danish Straits, between Denmark and Norway

places.name: Kattegat
places.significance: Second step of the Danish Straits, between Denmark and Sweden

places.name: Øresund
places.significance: Copenhagen's strait, crossed by the Øresund bridge-tunnel to Malmö

places.name: Denmark Strait
places.significance: Between Greenland and Iceland, with the greatest waterfall on Earth beneath it
notes: A submarine cataract of dense cold water, far larger than any on land

places.name: St George's Channel
places.significance: Southern entrance to the Irish Sea, between Ireland and Wales

places.name: Strait of Hormuz
places.significance: The world's most important oil chokepoint — a fifth of all petroleum passes through
notes: Iran on the north shore, Oman's Musandam exclave on the south

places.name: Bab-el-Mandeb
places.significance: The southern gate of the Red Sea — no Suez traffic reaches Asia without it
notes: Its name means "Gate of Tears"

places.name: Strait of Tiran
places.significance: Closing it to Israeli shipping helped trigger the 1967 war

places.name: Palk Strait
places.connects: Bay of Bengal ↔ Gulf of Mannar
places.significance: Separates India from Sri Lanka; too shallow for large ships
notes: Adam's Bridge (Rama Setu) runs across its southern end

places.name: Ten Degree Channel
places.significance: Separates the Andaman Islands from the Nicobar Islands

places.name: Nine Degree Channel
places.significance: Splits the Lakshadweep islands from Minicoy

places.name: Eight Degree Channel
places.significance: Separates India's Minicoy from the Maldives

places.name: Strait of Malacca
places.significance: Shortest sea route between the Indian and Pacific Oceans, and Asia's oil artery
notes: China's dependence on it is called the "Malacca dilemma"

places.name: Singapore Strait
places.connects: Strait of Malacca ↔ South China Sea
places.significance: The eastern end of the Malacca run, past the port of Singapore

places.name: Sunda Strait
places.significance: Between Java and Sumatra, with Krakatoa standing in the middle

places.name: Lombok Strait
places.significance: Deep alternative to Malacca for the largest ships; the Wallace Line runs through it

places.name: Makassar Strait
places.significance: Main channel of the Indonesian Throughflow, between Borneo and Sulawesi

places.name: Taiwan Strait
places.connects: East China Sea ↔ South China Sea
places.significance: The 180 km of water between China and Taiwan

places.name: Luzon Strait
places.significance: Deep-water gate between Taiwan and Luzon, watched closely by navies

places.name: Korea Strait
places.connects: East China Sea ↔ Sea of Japan
places.significance: Between Korea and Japan, with Tsushima island in midstream

places.name: Tsugaru Strait
places.significance: Separates Honshu from Hokkaido; the Seikan Tunnel runs under it

places.name: La Pérouse Strait
places.connects: Sea of Japan ↔ Sea of Okhotsk
places.significance: Between Hokkaido and Russian Sakhalin

places.name: Bering Strait
places.significance: The 82 km between Asia and America, and the old land bridge route
notes: The Diomede Islands sit in it, split by the date line

places.name: Mozambique Channel
places.connects: Indian Ocean ↔ Indian Ocean, around Madagascar
places.significance: Between Mozambique and Madagascar, the route for ships too big for Suez

places.name: Strait of Florida
places.significance: Where the Gulf Stream leaves the Gulf, between Florida and Cuba

places.name: Yucatán Channel
places.significance: The Caribbean's outlet into the Gulf, between Mexico and Cuba

places.name: Davis Strait
places.significance: Between Baffin Island and Greenland, the old Northwest Passage approach

places.name: Nares Strait
places.significance: Northernmost navigable strait, between Ellesmere Island and Greenland
notes: Hans Island in the strait was split between Canada and Denmark in 2022

places.name: Hudson Strait
places.significance: The only sea route into Hudson Bay

places.name: Strait of Juan de Fuca
places.significance: The sea border between Washington State and Vancouver Island

places.name: Drake Passage
places.significance: The roughest water in the world, between Cape Horn and Antarctica
notes: Nothing blocks the current here, which is why the seas build so high

places.name: Bass Strait
places.significance: Separates Tasmania from mainland Australia

places.name: Torres Strait
places.significance: Shallow, reef-strewn gap between Australia and Papua New Guinea

places.name: Cook Strait
places.significance: Separates New Zealand's North and South Islands

places.name: Suez Canal
places.significance: Cuts the Europe–Asia voyage by thousands of miles, avoiding Africa entirely
notes: Opened 1869; blocked by the Ever Given in 2021

places.name: Panama Canal
places.significance: Lock canal across Panama, sparing ships the trip round Cape Horn
notes: Opened 1914; handed to Panama in 1999

places.name: Kiel Canal
places.significance: Busiest artificial waterway in the world, cutting off the Danish Straits
